## Checklist

- [ ] The diff has no character names, player names, chat lines or log text, in code, tests, data, docs or screenshots.
- [ ] `python -m pytest` and `npm test` pass.
- [ ] `PYTHONPATH=pipeline python -m trioforge.privacy.scan --all` passes.
- [ ] A change to a rule edits `rules/rules.json` and keeps the rule's seal, source and date.
- [ ] I license my contribution under MIT (code) or CC BY-SA 4.0 (data).
